summary: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement on July 30, 2026, with institutional investors. It issued 191,571 common shares at $1.74 per share, pre-funded warrants for 383,142 shares, and Series A/B warrants for 574,413 shares each, raising about $1.0 million. Pre-funded warrants are exercisable at $0.001; common warrants at $1.49. Closing occurred July 31, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. The filing involves an equity raise with significant warrant coverage, potentially dilutive. Watch for registration statement effectiveness and downstream dilution effects.
